parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable
ASCII characters) that makes a retried request safe. The service always
runs on Postgres, so it is required on every deployment and answered
with 400 `idempotency-key-required` when absent (`idempotency-key-invalid`
when malformed). A replay with the same key, method, path and body
returns the original response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the
same key with a different method, path or body is 409
`idempotency-key-reused`.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: The receipt id (`rcpt-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).
